name: Figure 03
summary: Figure 03 is Figure AI's third-generation humanoid, designed around the company's Helix vision-language-action model for both home and commercial work. Figure lists it at 5 ft 8 in, 61 kg, 20 kg payload and 5 hours of runtime. BMW has announced a Figure 03 parts-sequencing deployment, while home use has not been offered to the public.
hands: Redesigned hands with palm cameras, softer fingertips and first-generation tactile sensors that Figure says detect about 3 g of pressure.
sensors: Next-generation camera system (Figure claims 2x frame rate, 1/4 latency and 60% wider field of view per camera vs Figure 02), palm cameras, fingertip tactile sensors.
highlights: Wireless inductive charging at 2 kW through coils in the feet.
Figure says Figure 03 has 9% less mass than Figure 02.
BMW Group announced in June 2026 that Figure 03 will sort parts into sequencing trolleys in logistics.
Built at Figure's BotQ facility, which the company says can make up to 12,000 robots per year.
caveats: No public price, pre-order or retail channel.
Home use has only been described as internal or partner testing.
Degrees of freedom are not published.

sources.title: BMW Group deploys Figure 03 humanoid after tests with previous version
